title: Gram determinant of a linear map on a subspace is independent of the orthonormal basis
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), let L : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be a continuous linear map, and let τ = (τ_1, …, τ_n) (indexed by Fin n) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P with span{τ_1, …, τ_n} = Q. Let e = (e_1, …, e_m), m = finrank Q, be Mathlib's standard orthonormal basis of Q (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ Q, indexed by Fin (finrank ℝ Q)), its vectors regarded in ℝ^P. Then det(⟨L e_i, L e_j⟩)_{i,j ∈ Fin m} = det(⟨L τ_a, L τ_b⟩)_{a,b ∈ Fin n}, where ⟨·,·⟩ is the Euclidean inner product. L need not be injective.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) = Q → Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ Q) => inner ℝ (L (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ Q i)) (L (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ Q j))) = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin n => inner ℝ (L (τ i)) (L (τ j)))
